description.value:
You extend a whip-like biotic tendril that snares an enemy and violently yanks them toward you, dealing damage on impact.

Choose a creature within 30 feet. The target must attempt a @Check[reflex|dc:resolve(13+@actor.system.details.level.value+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/3))|options:me-power:me-npc-biotic-lash] save against the creature's power DC.

Critical Success Unaffected.

Success The target takes @Damage[(1*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[bludgeoning]] damage.

Failure The target is pulled up to 30 feet toward you and takes @Damage[(2*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[bludgeoning]] damage. If pulled adjacent to you, it is Off-Guard until the start of your next turn.

Critical Failure As failure, but @Damage[(4*(1+floor(@actor.system.details.level.value/4)))d6[bludgeoning]] damage and the target is also Grabbed until the start of your next turn.

Recharge The creature can't use this power again for [[/br 1d4 #Recharge]]{1d4 rounds}.

NPC version. Its DC is 13 + level + a third of level (the moderate DC for the creature's level), and its damage dice multiply every 4 levels. When a creature rolls the save, the result is applied automatically (see the Auto-Apply Power Effects setting).
